Square Tubular Privacy Pocket Door Hardware

text.description_html:
Kwikset 335-SQT, Square Privacy Pocket Door Hardware

The Square Pocket Door Privacy Set is great for sliding pocket doors where privacy is desired. This Square Tubular Privacy Pocket Door Hardware features a 2-in-1 tubular latch with pop-out edge pull. The Pop Out Edge Pull is spring loaded and can be ejected from the door's edge with the press of a finger. This sliding door set will fit doors 1-3/8 inches to 1-3/4 inches thick with 2-3/8 inch backsets. The Square Privacy Pocket Door Hardware be easily unlocked from the outside via an emergency turn on the exterior plate. Available in a wide array of finish colors.

Pocket Door Privacy Function: Locks but has access to unlock from the outside via emergency turn. Privacy locks do not offer security, they offer privacy. It features a pop out edge pull to help retrieve the door from the pocket as well as a strike with dust box to receive the latch.

Also Available Matching: Square Passage Set for Pocket Doors

Specifications of the Privacy Square Sliding Door Trim:

  • Trim Plate Length: 2.44" square
  • Trim Plate Projection: 1.375"
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/8" - 1-3/4"
  • Backset: 2-3/8"
  • Cross Bore: 2-1/8''
  • Edge Bore: 1''
  • Faceplate: 1" x 2-3/4" round corner, steel. Accommodates flat and beveled doors.
  • Non-handed

*Sold as a Set: two (2) flush pulls, a pop-out edge pull, a privacy strike, dust box, and all mounting hardware. For One (1) Door.
